card.name: Monitoring and dosing interval words
card.fires_on: Words that set up a schedule, such as "and" before "then every", or "monthly", "weekly", "daily" and the number in "every 12 hours". Seen mostly in lab-monitoring and dosing-frequency instructions.

modes.label: Frequency words
modes.description: Monthly, weekly, daily or month after a test or dose instruction.
modes.example: Perform follow-up hepatic laboratory tests<< monthly>> for the first 3 months, at

modes.label: Numbers in intervals
modes.description: Digits inside an "every N hours/minutes/weeks" interval.
modes.example: Increase every 3<<0>> minutes to a maximum of 8 mg

modes.label: And before a schedule
modes.description: The word "and" joining a first time point to a later repeating schedule.
modes.example: 6 months after initiation of BAFIERTAM<< and>> then every 6 to
